purpose: Separate historical generator lineage from final-master proof completeness. A route can have a real historical BoltBeam + BubbleBeam/FutureSight + tinygrad lifecycle while still lacking the immutable package required by the stricter final-master contract.

system_roles.bubblebeam_futuresight: Candidate representation, bounded candidate enumeration, and static COALESCE/layout ranking where present.
system_roles.boltbeam: Workload/search policy, route-policy authority, evaluation and evidence linkage where present; later policy migration does not imply BoltBeam originally invented the kernel.
system_roles.tinygrad: Runtime guards and binding, graph or descriptor lowering, compiler/codegen, execution, and route observation.

facts: BubbleBeam/FutureSight enumerated lane_partition_q4k and row_serial_q4k and ranked them deterministically.
lane_partition_q4k won the static stride/vector-width ranking.
The selected LaneMap was lowered into the named G3 UOp route, validated, promoted, and later bound through BoltBeam route policy.
missing_for_final_master: One current-tree immutable export joining request, ranked population, selected LaneMap, deterministic lowering identity, source or plan hash, route binding, and hash-linked evidence.
A drift check proving the shipped artifact is the deterministic replay output rather than a manually edited bridge.
routes.next_action: Recover and replay the historical selector/lowering chain; do not invent a replacement Q4 search.

facts: The recovered promotion record proves route binding, token parity, and lossless emission, not candidate search or ranking.
missing_for_final_master: Route-bound combined-system candidate population, selection, and export chain.
routes.next_action: Exhaust history; only then replay an existing search or define a new one.

facts: The executing FlashDecodeAttentionSpec delegates to a hand-authored full tile/combine UOp closure.
missing_for_final_master: G4 candidate generation, ranked population, selected topology export, and deterministic generated artifact.
routes.next_action: Keep as dev oracle unless deeper history recovers a generator-owned topology.

facts: G5 has a separate guard and geometry but shares the hand-authored G4/G5 tile/combine closure.
missing_for_final_master: Independent G5 generator-owned topology and search/export evidence.
routes.next_action: Keep as dev oracle unless deeper history recovers a generator-owned topology.

facts: The descriptor delegates to a fixed-geometry hand-authored complete attention kernel builder.
missing_for_final_master: Search-owned primitive composition/topology and deterministic generated artifact for the admitted 8B and 14B shapes.
routes.next_action: Keep as dev oracle unless deeper history recovers a generator-owned topology.

facts: Four complete selected scheduler plan payloads and separate whole-prefill timing/correctness records survive in the archived worktree.
missing_for_final_master: Top-level request, search-space digest, run/ranking identity, exporter revision, and current-runtime drift binding.
routes.next_action: Preserve the recovered bundle and recover or replay only its missing header/binding chain.

facts: The route spec manually encodes layout, parts, loops, packed loads, reduction, store, and fixed options.
missing_for_final_master: Candidate population, ranking, selected-plan export, and route-bound generated artifact.
routes.next_action: Keep as dev oracle unless deeper history recovers a generator-owned topology.

facts: The route spec delegates to a hand-authored direct-packed lowering and reuses a hand-authored Q6 packed-dot/dequant primitive.
missing_for_final_master: Candidate population, ranking, selected-plan export, and route-bound generated artifact.
routes.next_action: Keep as dev oracle unless deeper history recovers a generator-owned topology.

facts: Ordinary tinygrad emits the kernel body, but the surviving PACKED_WMMA_GEOM selection table is a manually copied fixed table with no recovered search record.
missing_for_final_master: Shape-keyed request, candidate population/ranking, selected table rows, and hashes tying those rows to compiled/evidence identities.
routes.next_action: Exhaust history; rerun schedule search only if the original selection source cannot be recovered.

summary.operational_decision: Recovery and deterministic replay precede replacement search. No runtime or GPU work occurs in this phase.
